attributes.name: anchor-element
attributes.description: The anchor element (reference element), can be a string selector or an element.

attributes.name: anchored-element
attributes.description:
The anchored element (positioned element), can be a string selector or an element. Or the direct children of
`anchor-component`.

attributes.name: preferred-position-order
attributes.description: The preferred position area sequence. In which order to try to position the anchored element.

attributes.name: autoupdate
attributes.description: Uses `requestAnimationFrame` to always update the position. (default: `false`)
